🔄 I'd swap pushdowns for Low-to-High Cable Fly. It keeps your chest working with very little elbow load. Dips and overhead extensions stress the elbow even more, so I'd skip them today. Tap the card to swap.

⚠️ Your bench and presses also load the elbow. Keep the weight lighter and stop any movement that hurts. If the pain is sharp or doesn't go away, see a professional.

Is the pain worse when you press, or only when you straighten your arm?
